label: Rushing production
definition: The run game's own measures beyond Team Analytics: what a team does after a stuffed run, late and close, at the goal line, how much rides on big runs, the quarterback's carries, and the backfield workload. Offense, and what each defense faced. Sacks are never rushes; kneels are never plays.

garbage_time.policy: Dual-surfaced: `all` counts every snap; `competitive` drops garbage time (play_filters.is_garbage_time).

team.label: Run again after a stuffed run
team.definition: On 2nd or 3rd down, the snap right after a run stuffed for 0 or less in the same drive: share that are runs.

team.label: Success running right after a stuff
team.defense_label: Success allowed on runs right after a stuff
team.definition: Success rate of those follow-up runs.

team.label: Success passing right after a stuff
team.defense_label: Success allowed on passes right after a stuff
team.definition: Success rate of follow-up passes after a stuffed run.

team.label: Run rate, late and close
team.definition: 4th quarter or overtime, within one score (play_filters.is_late_and_close_state): runs / (runs + dropbacks).

team.label: Rush success, late and close
team.defense_label: Rush success allowed, late and close

team.label: Yards per carry, late and close
team.defense_label: Yards per carry allowed, late and close
team.definition: Rush yards / carries, late and close.

team.label: Stuff rate, late and close
team.definition: Carries for 0 or less, late and close.

team.label: Goal-to-go rush TD rate
team.definition: Carries with goal to go (play_filters.is_goal_to_go_snap) that scored.

team.label: Share of rush yards from explosive runs
team.definition: Rush yards on explosive runs (the engine's yardage flag, 12+) / all rush yards. High = big-play dependent.

team.label: QB rush success
team.definition: Success rate on carries by a quarterback (positions.is_quarterback: rostered QB or 10+ pass attempts).

team.label: QB carries on passing downs
team.definition: Share of quarterback carries on passing downs (the engine's flag): the scramble sign.

team.label: Rush success, non-QB carries
team.definition: Success rate on carries by everyone but quarterbacks.

team.label: Yards per carry, non-QB
team.definition: Rush yards / carries by everyone but quarterbacks.

team.label: Lead back's share of non-QB carries
team.definition: The non-QB with the most carries: his share of non-QB carries.

team.label: Backfield concentration (HHI)
team.definition: Herfindahl over non-QB carriers: 1 = one back takes every carry, lower = a committee.

team.label: Lead back success, 1st half
team.definition: Success rate of the lead back's 1st-half carries.

team.label: Lead back success, 2nd half
team.definition: Success rate of the lead back's 2nd-half carries.

players.label: Share of yards from explosive runs
players.definition: Yards on explosive runs (12+) / rush yards.

players.label: Carries on passing downs
players.definition: Share of carries on passing downs.

players.label: Success, carries 1-8 of a game
players.definition: The back's 1st to 8th carries of each game.

players.label: Success right after a stuff
players.definition: His carries on the snap after a team run was stuffed (same drive).

player_qualify: sample (carries) >= 5 per team game; ranks are among qualified players only
notes: Run direction (share, yards, stuffs, EPA by lane) is published in team-analytics/spatial_{season}.json rush_lanes; it is not counted again here.
Opponent-adjusted rush EPA per carry is a ridge fit (25-Season/build_team_ratings.fit_ratings at DESCRIPTIVE_LAMBDA) on each game's rush EPA per carry: `adjusted` per team.
adjusted_definition: Opponent-adjusted rush EPA per carry is a ridge fit (25-Season/build_team_ratings.fit_ratings at DESCRIPTIVE_LAMBDA) on each game's rush EPA per carry: `adjusted` per team.
